name: Ioun Stone Dark Green Rhomboid
body:
Dark Green Rhomboid (Normal) Ioun Stone
Source Dungeoneer's Handbook pg. 28
Aura strong divination; CL 12th
Slot none; Price 8,000 gp; Weight —
Description
This ioun stone is forest green with flecks of yellow. At all times, it allows you to immediately notice any poison within 5 feet of you. This effect is otherwise identical to the detect poison spell.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, detect poison, creator must be 12th level; Cost 4,000 gp
